name: wireguard
description: WireGuard for lwIP on the ESP32: esphome-libs/wireguard (droscy/esp_wireguard) v0.4.8, commit 9b7660fed27151abdcbf32b43861044cf4a32497, vendored for PsiConnect with two small marked changes (see the top of src/esp_wireguard.c).
